description:
To Gyu-bin, who has been suffering from the hardships of life was invited to have some free alcohol with Sun-woo, the man next door. Being addicted to free drinks, Gyu-bin decides to go to his house. When he wakes up drunk, he realized he had kiss marks all over his body! The thrilling life of a sexy neighbor and an absurdly average person.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_reason_wz), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/nb_4jeong), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/ejaculate_of_neighborhood), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8321253)
